items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Red said, 'Paul, that's the cat I been tellin' you about.' Paul said, 'I'm ready for him.' ... Paul said, 'I'll find out tonight.'

ctx.x: Paul was playing at the Bluebird over in Virginia.
Yeah, he and Red Elkins. Red was playing with Paul at the Bluebird Inn. And Julius Pogue.
So you went up to 7th and T..
